_comment: Per-camera optics. SINGLE SOURCE for both scripts:
scripts/add_cameras.py   authors the USD cameras you look through
They used to each carry their own default and could silently drift, so a table
and a picture would stop describing the same sensor. Read from here instead.
hfov is the HORIZONTAL field of view in degrees. Vertical follows from the 4:3
aperture, so 120 H gives about 98 V.
These are CHOICES, not measurements: no lens has been selected for this machine.
Pick real parts and put their numbers here.

cam_house_front._why: Sits low on the front deck, so at any useful down-angle the ground fills a lot of the frame. A wide lens buys back the context above the horizon without giving up the near ground.

cam_cab_roof._why: Covers both the cups and the row from one mount; it needs the breadth.

cam_fork_mast._why: Looks down at the stack from 1.2 m. Wide enough to hold the whole module plus the cups coming in.

cam_tool_side._why: Close-range grip check at 1.1 m. Wider than this and the cups get small in frame, which is the opposite of the point.
